login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Use the email provided by your administrator to access the system.
login.heroText: One unified platform for students, lecturers, and managers to operate shared laboratory resources efficiently every day.
login.resetSuccessText: You can now sign in with your new password.
login.adminNote: Accounts are centrally managed by Admin. Contact an administrator if you have not received an account.

forgot.title: Forgot password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email. The system will send a password reset link valid for one hour.
forgot.security: For security, the system does not disclose whether an email exists.
forgot.sentText: If the email exists in the system, a reset link has been sent to
forgot.completedText: The password reset was completed in another tab. This tab is no longer waiting for the request.
forgot.closeHint: Gmail or your browser may open the link in a new tab. That is browser behavior, not an extra application screen.
forgot.timeout: Your request has been accepted. Please check your inbox in a few minutes.
forgot.connectionError: Could not connect to the server. Please try again.
forgot.gmailSameTabHint: Open Gmail to replace this confirmation page with your inbox, so no extra confirmation tab is left open.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password that is different from your previous password.
reset.strengthHint: Use uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.
reset.mismatch: The confirmation password does not match.
reset.missingToken: The reset link is missing a token. Open the exact link from the email.
reset.successText: Your new password has been saved. The previous browser session was cleared so you can sign in safely.
reset.requestError: The request took too long or the connection was interrupted. Please try again.
reset.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current password.
reset.connectionError: The request timed out or the connection was interrupted. Please try again.

requestReset.title: Reset password
requestReset.subtitle: Request a secure link for the account that is currently signed in. Opening that email link takes you to the separate screen where you create a new password.
requestReset.emailHint: The reset link is sent only to the email currently assigned to this account.
requestReset.connectionError: Could not connect to the server. Please try again.
requestReset.step3: Create and confirm a new password
requestReset.distinction: Forgot password is the public email-request screen. Reset password is the separate token-based flow for creating a new password.

layout.subtitle: Manage shared laboratory rooms and equipment

preview.utilizationHint: Updated from bookings and usage logs

featureSection.title: Everything needed to run labs efficiently
featureSection.subtitle: Role-based interfaces reduce unnecessary steps and keep important data easy to scan.

booking.title: Smart booking
booking.description: Check conflicts, prioritize requests, and suggest suitable time slots.

resources.title: Resource management
resources.description: Track labs, equipment, status, and usage history in one place.

maintenance.title: Proactive maintenance
maintenance.description: Schedule one-time or recurring maintenance and control costs.

dashboard.title: Visual dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitor KPIs, utilization, no-shows, and operational trends.

workflowSection.title: From request to completion in one flow
workflowSection.subtitle: Status, timing, and responsible users stay visible throughout the process.

resource.title: Choose resources
resource.description: Find labs or equipment by status and need.

time.title: Choose time
time.description: Check availability and submit a booking request.

approval.title: Approve & notify
approval.description: Lab managers process requests by scope and priority.

usage.title: Use & monitor
usage.description: Check-in, check-out, incidents, and reports stay connected.

cta.title: Open the Shared Lab workspace
cta.subtitle: Sign in with an administrator-issued account to view calendars, book resources, or manage the entire system.

systemMaintenance.title: System Maintenance
systemMaintenance.subtitle: Control system-wide maintenance mode and the notice displayed to users.

fields.placeholder: Example: The system will be unavailable for an upgrade from 22:00 to 23:00. Please finish your work beforehand.

systemMaintenance.savedLocally: The settings are updated immediately after saving.

preview.title: What users will see
preview.defaultMessage: The system is being maintained. Please return after the expected maintenance window.
preview.normalMessage: All features are ready to use.

note.title: Operational note
note.text: Set a clear maintenance window and prepare a concise notice so users can plan their work.

validation.timeRequired: Enter both the expected start and end time.
validation.timeOrder: The end time must be later than the start time.
validation.messageRequired: Enter the message shown to users.

toast.enabledText: The maintenance notice has been updated in the interface.
toast.disabledText: The system has returned to normal operation.
